bugs_found: compound_interest converts years to float and then uses Decimal ** float, which raises TypeError for normal valid inputs; also introduces precision drift if fixed naively
compounds_per_year and months are coerced with int(), silently truncating fractional values instead of validating integrality
transfer is not atomic: source balance is assigned before destination credit, so a later failure can leave funds debited without credit
transfer rejects only object-identity self-transfers; two Account objects with the same id can transfer to themselves logically
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, unlike the other money functions, causing inconsistent behavior and type-triggered failures
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min or fee_pct-derived fee exceeds amount
fx_convert does not validate exchange rates as positive finite values, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity conversions
money outputs are not quantized to currency precision, so rounding behavior is undeclared and context-dependent
